quests.title: The Dead Patch at Cronulla
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. The number three green at Cronulla has had a bald patch the shape of Tasmania since the Sunday after payday, and the committee thinks I am inventing it. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: the patch, with something in frame for scale
bring it to me before the meeting

quests.title: Turf Money, Cronulla
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. They have seen the photograph and now they want it re-laid by the Sunday after payday, which means finding $87 that the Cronulla club does not have. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: $87, however you like, I am not asking
put it in my hand, not the safe

quests.title: The Cronulla Membership Count
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. Our books say 60 members at Cronulla and I would bet the bar takings that half of them are dead or moved to Queensland. It started small, the way these things do. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: stand at the side door where the list is kept
the board with the names still on it
read me the ones you did not recognise

quests.title: Closing Time Rumour, Cronulla
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. Since the back of seven somebody has been going round the Cronulla greens telling the barefoot bowlers we are shutting, and we are not shutting. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: whoever is doing the telling
and take the bar money off them while you are there

quests.title: Behind the Bar at Cronulla
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. There is an esky with no lid in the chest freezer behind the bar at Cronulla and I am not opening it on an empty stomach. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: get one into you first, seriously
round the back where the cellar door is
whatever is in there, before I lose my nerve

quests.title: The Old Greenkeeper, Cronulla
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. The man who kept these greens before me drinks at Woolooware now, and he owes Cronulla an explanation about the drainage. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: find him and hear him out
come back and tell me what he said

quests.title: Nights at Artarmon
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. Every night around just gone midnight the same car does three laps of the Artarmon forecourt and never buys fuel. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: the car, plate if you can get it
I want it on record before I ring anyone

quests.title: The Third Lap, Artarmon
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. Now I know the plate, I want to know where it goes after it leaves Artarmon at just gone midnight, because it is not going home. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: follow it as far as Chatswood
wherever it stops

quests.title: Bay Two, Artarmon
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. Bay two at the Artarmon workshop has had the same car in it since grand final week and the owner has stopped answering. It started small, the way these things do. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: the address on the job card
the letterbox, so I know I have the right house
tell me if anybody actually lives there

quests.title: Tools Off the Bench, Artarmon
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. Someone has been walking out of Artarmon with a socket set at a time since grand final week, and I have run out of ways to be polite about it. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: the ones hanging round the air hose
$91 of it back, that is what the set cost

quests.title: The Artarmon Price Board
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Head office says the Artarmon board has been wrong since grand final week and I say it has been right for eleven years, and one of us is about to be embarrassed. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: buy something so it is a real transaction
the board and the pump, both in the one shot
that settles it either way

quests.title: The Other Franchise, Artarmon
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. The bloke who runs the site at Chatswood has had the same trouble Artarmon has, and he will talk to you before he talks to me. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: find him on shift
whatever he says, I want it word for word

quests.title: Level Two, Jannali
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. Water has been coming through the level two ceiling of the Jannali block since the first of the month and the strata report says there is no water. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: the ceiling, with the stain visible
that goes in the file whether they like it or not

quests.title: The Special Levy, Jannali
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. The photo did it. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Now every owner at Jannali owes $67 and I have to collect it from people who have avoided me for a year. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: $67 out of them, in any state
I will not ask how

quests.title: Car Space 14, Jannali
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. Somebody who does not live at Jannali has parked in space fourteen every night since the first of the month and the manager will not look at it. It started small, the way these things do. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: down to the basement, the far corner
the car in the space with the number painted beside it

quests.title: The Meeting, Jannali
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. The Jannali AGM is on the first of the month and I would like to arrive with something stronger than a grievance and a printout. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: two coffees, one is for me
the community room where they hold it
walk in with me, they behave when there is a witness

quests.title: Bin Night at Jannali
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Three units at Jannali have put their bins out on the wrong night since the first of the month and I have taken it personally, which I accept is a choice I made. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: the ones who argue about it
the fine the council gave me, off them

quests.title: The Other Block, Jannali
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. There is a block at Como with the same builder and the same cracks, and their manager has already been through what Jannali is starting. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: go and ask them how it ended
I need to know how much worse this gets
